question:
**Direction: In the following questions, a sentence is given. In the options different one word substitute have been suggested. You have to choose the best one.**

Incapable of being effaced, or cancelled.
solution:
The correct answer is "Indelible".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the selected word:
 
 
• Indelible- (of ink or a pen) making marks that cannot be removed.
 
• Example: The mark created by that pen is indelible.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **"option 2"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the other words:
 
 
• Incurable- which can not be cured
 
• Biped- an animal that uses two legs for walking.
 
• **Stale- **(of food) no longer fresh and pleasant to eat; hard, musty, or dry.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• Meanings in Hindi:
 
 
• Indelible- जिसको मिटाया न जा सके 

 
 
• Example: The mark created by that pen is indelible.
 
 
 
• Incurable- जिसको ठीक न किया जा सके 
 
• Biped- दो पैरों का
 
• Stale- बासी
